description: This file defines the class 'tlvTransmitterLinkMetric' which models a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure related to transmitter link metrics in IEEE 1905.1 network management. It includes enums, data structures, and method declarations for handling link metrics, interface pairs, and related information.
